svg.aria-label: Crisis navigation chart: ACT choice point — toward or away. Start: "A tricky moment". Steps: from "A tricky moment", go to "Hooks: hard thoughts & feelings show up"; from "Hooks: hard thoughts & feelings show up", if hooked go to "Away move: avoid, lash out, shut down"; from "Hooks: hard thoughts & feelings show up", if unhook go to "Toward move: unhook, act on values"; from "Toward move: unhook, act on values", go to "Who/what matters to me". Crisis resources are always shown: If you are in danger now, call your local emergency number or a crisis line (use your local number).
